# Laura

> LOW-rah — a TUI workspace your agent builds with you while you pair-program. Laura hosts your agent's shell in a PTY, and you or the agent open files into live panels — splitting the tab into a composable tree of panes. Mark a file up in place and your review is injected straight back into the agent's chat. The show → react → revise loop never leaves the terminal.

## Docs

- [Tutorial](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/tutorial.md): A step-by-step walkthrough for humans.
- [Navigating the TUI](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/navigation.md): The keystrokes to navigate within a Laura workspace for humans.
- [Agent reference](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/agent-reference.md): Common usage reference for the `laura` CLI for agents.
- [CLI reference](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/cli.md): Complete reference of the `laura` CLI commands and flags for agents.
- [Protocol](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/protocol.md): How tiling and interactions work across processes for agents.
